items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: he had reached -- swear me in and made me an official honorary citizen of Odessa, Texas... one of the bright happy lights in my life... he wouldn't miss them for the world

ctx.x: Now for the Odessa party. For the past two years, we've missed the original ingredient for the Odessa party. I'll go on to explain.

The Odessa party was a dream of a gentleman, Dr. O.A. Jim Fulcher, who was an eminent surgeon and a lover of jazz music. After visiting Gibson's parties as a guest, he got together with a few influential citizens in Odessa, Texas, and they formed a committee called the Odessa Jazz Unlimited Incorporation.
They backed the first concerts there. Their first parties were also private parties -- it was a guest list, invitation only -- and they still are. Their list is sold out,
